name: ChatGPT
description: Advanced conversational AI powered by GPT-4 for writing, coding, and problem-solving
longDescription: ChatGPT is OpenAI's flagship conversational AI assistant powered by GPT-4 and GPT-4 Turbo. It excels at natural language understanding, code generation, creative writing, analysis, and multi-modal tasks. With voice and image capabilities, it's one of the most versatile AI assistants available.
pricingDetails: Free tier with GPT-3.5, Plus subscription at $20/month for GPT-4 access

name: Midjourney
description: AI-powered image generation tool for creating stunning artistic visuals
longDescription: Midjourney is an independent research lab that produces some of the most artistic and visually stunning AI-generated images. Known for its unique aesthetic and high-quality outputs, it's popular among artists, designers, and creatives seeking beautiful, stylized imagery.
pricingDetails: Basic plan at $10/month, Standard at $30/month, Pro at $60/month

name: Notion AI
description: AI-powered writing assistant seamlessly integrated into Notion workspace
longDescription: Notion AI enhances your Notion workspace with intelligent writing assistance. It helps with content generation, editing, summarization, brainstorming, and translation, all within your existing Notion pages and databases.
pricingDetails: Free trial, then $10/month per user for AI features

name: Claude
description: Anthropic's advanced AI assistant focused on helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty
longDescription: Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant built with Constitutional AI principles. It excels at analysis, writing, coding, and long-form content creation. Known for its strong reasoning capabilities and ethical approach, Claude can process up to 200K tokens of context.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro subscription at $20/month

name: Google Gemini
description: Google's multimodal AI model for text, images, audio, and video
longDescription: Google Gemini is a powerful multimodal AI model that can understand and generate text, images, audio, and video. Available in multiple sizes (Ultra, Pro, Flash), it's integrated into Google's ecosystem and offers strong reasoning capabilities.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Advanced subscription at $20/month

name: DALL-E 3
description: OpenAI's advanced image generation model with exceptional prompt understanding
longDescription: DALL-E 3 is OpenAI's latest image generation model, known for its superior understanding of natural language prompts and ability to create highly detailed, coherent images. Integrated with ChatGPT for enhanced prompt engineering.
pricingDetails: Available through ChatGPT Plus ($20/month) or API usage

name: Stable Diffusion
description: Open-source AI image generation model with extensive customization options
longDescription: Stable Diffusion is an open-source latent diffusion model for generating images from text prompts. It can run locally, offers extensive customization through models and extensions, and is popular among developers and artists who want control over their AI image generation.
pricingDetails: Open-source (free), API and cloud services available

name: GitHub Copilot
description: AI pair programmer that suggests code as you type
longDescription: GitHub Copilot is an AI-powered code completion tool that suggests entire lines or blocks of code as you type. Trained on billions of lines of code, it helps developers write code faster and more efficiently across multiple programming languages.
pricingDetails: Individual at $10/month, Business at $19/user/month

name: Cursor
description: AI-powered code editor built for pair programming with AI
longDescription: Cursor is a code editor designed from the ground up for AI pair programming. It combines the power of GPT-4 with advanced code understanding to help you write, edit, and refactor code more efficiently.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $20/month

name: Jasper
description: AI content creation platform for marketing and business content
longDescription: Jasper is an AI writing assistant designed specifically for marketing teams and businesses. It helps create blog posts, social media content, ad copy, product descriptions, and more with brand voice consistency.
pricingDetails: Creator plan at $49/month, Teams at $125/month, Business custom pricing

name: Copy.ai
description: AI-powered copywriting tool for marketing and sales content
longDescription: Copy.ai helps marketers and sales teams create compelling copy for ads, emails, social media, websites, and more. With over 90 templates and workflows, it's designed to speed up content creation.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $49/month, Team at $249/month

name: Runway ML
description: AI-powered video editing and generation platform
longDescription: Runway ML is a creative suite powered by AI for video editing, generation, and manipulation. It offers tools for video generation, object removal, motion tracking, green screen, and more advanced video editing capabilities.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Standard at $15/month, Pro at $35/month

name: Synthesia
description: AI video generation platform with realistic AI avatars
longDescription: Synthesia creates professional videos using AI avatars that can speak in over 120 languages. Perfect for training videos, marketing content, and presentations without the need for cameras, actors, or studios.
pricingDetails: Starter at $29/month, Creator at $89/month, Enterprise custom pricing

name: Perplexity AI
description: AI-powered search engine with conversational answers and citations
longDescription: Perplexity AI combines search engine capabilities with conversational AI to provide accurate, cited answers to questions. It searches the web in real-time and provides sources for all information, making it ideal for research and fact-checking.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $20/month

name: Grammarly
description: AI-powered writing assistant for grammar, style, and clarity
longDescription: Grammarly is an AI-powered writing assistant that helps improve grammar, spelling, punctuation, clarity, and style. Available as a browser extension, desktop app, and mobile keyboard, it works across platforms and applications.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Premium at $12/month, Business at $15/user/month

name: Figma AI
description: AI features integrated into Figma for design assistance
longDescription: Figma AI brings intelligent design assistance to the popular design tool. It helps with design generation, component creation, layout suggestions, and design system management.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Professional at $12/month, Organization at $45/month

name: Canva AI
description: AI-powered design tools integrated into Canva
longDescription: Canva AI includes Magic Design, Magic Eraser, Background Remover, and text-to-image generation. These features help users create professional designs quickly without advanced design skills.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $12.99/month, Teams at $14.99/user/month

name: Zapier
description: AI-powered workflow automation platform
longDescription: Zapier connects apps and automates workflows. With AI features, it can intelligently route data, transform information, and make decisions in automated workflows across thousands of apps.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Starter at $19.99/month, Professional at $49/month

name: Make (Integromat)
description: Visual automation platform for complex workflows
longDescription: Make (formerly Integromat) is a visual automation platform that allows you to create complex, multi-step automations with conditional logic, data transformation, and error handling.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Core at $9/month, Pro at $16/month

name: HubSpot AI
description: AI-powered CRM and marketing automation platform
longDescription: HubSpot AI enhances the CRM platform with intelligent features for sales, marketing, and customer service. It includes content generation, email optimization, predictive analytics, and automated workflows.
pricingDetails: Free CRM available, Starter at $20/month, Professional at $800/month

name: Tabnine
description: AI code completion tool for faster development
longDescription: Tabnine is an AI-powered code completion tool that learns from your codebase to provide accurate, context-aware suggestions. It supports all major programming languages and integrates with popular IDEs.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $12/month, Enterprise custom pricing

name: Replicate
description: Platform for running and deploying AI models
longDescription: Replicate makes it easy to run and deploy open-source AI models. With a simple API, you can access thousands of pre-trained models for image generation, language models, video processing, and more.
pricingDetails: Pay per API call, pricing varies by model

name: ElevenLabs
description: AI voice generation and text-to-speech platform
longDescription: ElevenLabs creates realistic, natural-sounding AI voices for text-to-speech, voice cloning, and dubbing. Used for audiobooks, podcasts, videos, and interactive applications.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Starter at $5/month, Creator at $22/month

name: Descript
description: AI-powered video and audio editing through text
longDescription: Descript allows you to edit video and audio by editing text transcripts. It includes AI features like Overdub for voice cloning, Studio Sound for audio enhancement, and automatic transcription.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Creator at $12/month, Pro at $24/month

name: Khan Academy AI
description: AI tutor and learning assistant from Khan Academy
longDescription: Khan Academy's AI tutor, Khanmigo, provides personalized learning assistance, helps with homework, and guides students through problems without giving direct answers, encouraging critical thinking.
pricingDetails: $4/month for students, $9/month for teachers

name: Duolingo Max
description: AI-powered language learning with GPT-4 integration
longDescription: Duolingo Max uses GPT-4 to provide personalized language learning experiences with roleplay scenarios and explain my answer features, making language learning more interactive and contextual.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Super at $6.99/month, Max at $9.99/month

name: Tableau
description: AI-powered data visualization and analytics platform
longDescription: Tableau uses AI and machine learning to help users discover insights from data through natural language queries, automated insights, and predictive analytics. It makes data analysis accessible to non-technical users.
pricingDetails: Creator at $70/month, Explorer at $42/month, Viewer at $15/month

name: Power BI
description: Microsoft's AI-powered business analytics platform
longDescription: Power BI combines business intelligence with AI capabilities including natural language queries, automated insights, and predictive analytics. Integrated with Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $10/user/month, Premium at $20/user/month

name: Salesforce Einstein
description: AI-powered CRM and business automation platform
longDescription: Salesforce Einstein brings AI to CRM with predictive analytics, automated workflows, lead scoring, opportunity insights, and intelligent recommendations across sales, service, and marketing.
pricingDetails: Starter at $25/user/month, Professional at $75/user/month, Enterprise at $150/user/month

name: Otter.ai
description: AI-powered meeting transcription and note-taking
longDescription: Otter.ai automatically transcribes meetings, generates summaries, and creates action items. It can identify speakers, capture slides, and integrate with popular video conferencing tools.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $10/month, Business at $20/user/month

name: n8n
description: Open-source workflow automation platform for connecting apps and services
longDescription: n8n is a powerful, open-source workflow automation tool that allows you to connect different services and automate tasks. It features a visual workflow editor, self-hosting capabilities, and extensive integrations with hundreds of apps and services.
pricingDetails: Open-source (free), Cloud plans start at $20/month, Self-hosted available

name: Get Shit Done (GSD)
description: Spec-driven development system for AI coding assistants
longDescription: Get Shit Done (GSD) is a lightweight, spec-driven development system designed for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. It solves context rot by using meta-prompting and context engineering to keep work organized. Each atomic task runs in a clean subagent context to prevent quality degradation.
pricingDetails: Open-source, free to use via npx

name: Base44
description: AI-powered platform for building apps in minutes with npm package support
longDescription: Base44 is an AI-powered platform that lets you build applications quickly using natural language. It features an npm package system, allowing you to add any public npm library through the AI chat interface. Includes SDK for JavaScript/TypeScript development with modules for agents, authentication, data entities, and integrations.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro plans start at $29/month

name: LangChain
description: Framework for building applications with LLMs through composability
longDescription: LangChain is a framework for developing applications powered by language models. It provides tools for chaining together different components, managing memory, and building complex AI applications. Available as Python and JavaScript/TypeScript libraries.
pricingDetails: Open-source, free to use

name: Bubble
description: Visual programming platform for building web applications without code
longDescription: Bubble is a no-code platform that allows you to build web applications visually. It features a drag-and-drop interface, database management, API integrations, and responsive design capabilities. Perfect for building MVPs and full applications without writing code.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Personal at $29/month, Professional at $129/month

name: AutoGPT
description: Autonomous AI agent that can perform tasks independently
longDescription: AutoGPT is an experimental open-source application that uses GPT-4 to autonomously achieve goals. It can break down complex tasks into subtasks, search the web, write files, and execute code. It's designed to work autonomously with minimal human intervention.
pricingDetails: Open-source, free to use (requires OpenAI API key)

name: Anthropic Claude API
description: API for integrating Claude AI into your applications
longDescription: Anthropic's Claude API provides access to Claude's language models for building AI-powered applications. It offers multiple model sizes, streaming support, function calling, and tools for building conversational AI applications.
pricingDetails: Pay per token, pricing varies by model

name: Vercel AI SDK
description: TypeScript SDK for building AI applications with React, Vue, and Svelte
longDescription: Vercel AI SDK provides a unified interface for working with AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more. It includes React hooks, streaming support, and tools for building AI-powered user interfaces.
pricingDetails: Open-source, free to use

name: Hugging Face
description: Platform for building, training, and deploying machine learning models
longDescription: Hugging Face provides tools and resources for the machine learning community. It offers model hosting, datasets, Spaces for demos, Transformers library, and Inference API for running models. It's the go-to platform for open-source AI models.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $9/month, Enterprise custom pricing

name: Pinecone
description: Vector database for building AI applications with semantic search
longDescription: Pinecone is a managed vector database that makes it easy to add semantic search, recommendations, and other AI features to applications. It's optimized for similarity search and works seamlessly with embeddings from OpenAI, Cohere, and other providers.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Standard at $70/month, Enterprise custom pricing

name: Cohere
description: AI platform for text generation, classification, and embeddings
longDescription: Cohere provides enterprise-grade language models for text generation, classification, and embeddings. It offers Command models for generation, Embed models for semantic search, and Classify models for text classification. Designed for developers building production AI applications.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pay-as-you-go pricing

name: Loom
description: AI-powered video messaging and screen recording tool
longDescription: Loom allows you to record and share quick video messages. With AI features, it can generate transcripts, summaries, and action items from your videos. Perfect for async communication, tutorials, and feedback.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Business at $8/user/month, Enterprise custom pricing

name: Framer
description: AI-powered design and prototyping tool for interactive websites
longDescription: Framer combines design and code in one platform. With AI features, it can generate designs, write code, and create interactive prototypes. It's perfect for designers who want to build production-ready websites without extensive coding.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $5/month, Team at $20/user/month

name: NotebookLM
description: Google's AI-powered note-taking and research assistant
longDescription: NotebookLM is Google's AI note-taking tool that can read your documents and answer questions about them. It creates a personalized AI that's grounded in your sources, making it perfect for research, study, and knowledge management.
pricingDetails: Currently free to use

name: Character.AI
description: Platform for creating and chatting with AI characters
longDescription: Character.AI allows you to create and interact with AI characters. You can chat with historical figures, fictional characters, or create your own custom characters. It's popular for entertainment, roleplay, and creative writing.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, c.ai+ at $9.99/month

name: Microsoft Copilot
description: AI assistant integrated into Microsoft 365 for productivity workflows
longDescription: Microsoft Copilot brings AI assistance directly into Microsoft 365 apps including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams. It helps with writing, data analysis, presentations, email composition, and meeting summaries, seamlessly integrated into your existing workflow.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Microsoft 365 Copilot at $30/user/month

name: DeepL
description: Most accurate AI translation tool for natural language output
longDescription: DeepL is widely considered the most accurate AI translation tool available. It provides natural, context-aware translations in over 30 languages, outperforming competitors in quality and nuance. Used by professionals worldwide for accurate multilingual communication.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $6.99/month, Advanced at $24.99/month

name: Suno AI
description: AI music generation platform for creating original songs
longDescription: Suno AI allows anyone to create original music with AI. Simply describe the style, mood, and lyrics you want, and Suno generates complete songs with vocals, instruments, and production. Perfect for musicians, content creators, and anyone wanting to create music without technical skills.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $10/month, Premier at $30/month

name: Gamma
description: AI-powered presentation and document creation platform
longDescription: Gamma creates beautiful presentations, documents, and web pages from simple text prompts. It automatically designs layouts, adds visuals, and formats content professionally. Perfect for creating engaging presentations quickly without design skills.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $10/month, Team at $20/user/month

name: Pika Labs
description: AI video generation platform for creating short videos
longDescription: Pika Labs is an AI video generation tool that creates high-quality short videos from text prompts or images. It's known for its ease of use and ability to generate cinematic, smooth video content. Popular among content creators and marketers.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $28/month

name: Ideogram
description: AI image generation with superior text rendering
longDescription: Ideogram specializes in generating images with accurate text rendering, making it ideal for creating graphics, logos, posters, and designs that include text. It combines high-quality image generation with reliable text placement and styling.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $8/month, Max at $20/month

name: Blackbox AI
description: AI coding assistant with real-time code search and autocomplete
longDescription: Blackbox AI is a powerful coding assistant that provides real-time code search, autocomplete, and code generation. It can search codebases, answer coding questions, and help with debugging. Available as browser extension and IDE plugin.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $9.99/month

name: Tavily
description: AI-powered research API for deep web search and analysis
longDescription: Tavily is an AI research API that performs deep web searches and provides comprehensive, cited research results. It's designed for AI agents and applications that need accurate, up-to-date information from the web with proper source attribution.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro at $20/month, Enterprise custom pricing

name: Claude Artifacts
description: Interactive code editor and document viewer within Claude
longDescription: Claude Artifacts is a feature that allows Claude to create and display interactive content like code editors, documents, and visualizations directly in the chat interface. Users can see code run, documents render, and interact with generated content in real-time.
pricingDetails: Available with Claude Pro subscription at $20/month

name: Kling AI
description: Advanced AI video generation with cinematic quality
longDescription: Kling AI is a powerful video generation platform that creates high-quality, cinematic videos from text prompts. It's known for producing smooth, realistic motion and professional-quality outputs. Popular among filmmakers and content creators.
pricingDetails: Free tier available, Pro plans starting at $9.99/month

name: ComfyUI
description: Powerful node-based interface for Stable Diffusion workflows
longDescription: ComfyUI is a node-based interface for creating complex Stable Diffusion workflows. It offers advanced control over image generation, inpainting, upscaling, and more. Popular among power users who want maximum control over their AI image generation process.
pricingDetails: Open-source, free to use
